summary: Linux and platform engineer with 9 years in software delivery. I design and run the secure Linux infrastructure behind Slovakia's national e-government — RHEL-based clusters on private-cloud virtualisation and bare metal, provisioned as code, hardened, monitored and patched — and I own the security layer on top of it: secrets, identity, network segmentation and supply-chain scanning. I came up as a software developer, so I automate in Python and Bash rather than by hand.

experience.name: NASES — National e-Government Platform
bullets: Design and operate the multi-cluster Linux platform behind slovensko.sk — RHEL-family nodes (Red Hat CoreOS / OpenShift) running on Oracle Private Cloud Appliance virtualisation and bare-metal servers.
Install, configure and maintain that infrastructure entirely as code with Terraform/OpenTofu; everything else is automated in Python and Bash rather than done by hand.

Own the security layer: secrets management (Vault), identity and access (Keycloak), network policy and segmentation (Cilium, Fortinet, F5), TLS/certificates, plus image signing and vulnerability scanning enforced in the shared GitLab CI pipelines.

Run observability end to end (Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic) and handle day-to-day operations across the estate: patching, hardening, troubleshooting and incident response on sovereign, regulated national infrastructure.

experience.name: LiveAgent
bullets: Ran the Linux production infrastructure on AWS (Terraform) behind a help-desk SaaS used by tens of thousands of companies: MariaDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, messaging and background workers.
Six years of development on the product itself (PHP, Java, Python, JavaScript); two years on the leadership team, mentoring engineers and running hiring.

experience.name: Medical Navigator
bullets: Built the infrastructure and CI/CD for a multilingual healthcare directory: GitHub Actions pipelines and a multi-account Terraform setup deploying containers to AWS ECS Fargate behind an ALB.

experience.name: DXC Technology
bullets: Delivered an internal race-organisation web application end to end on a two-person team — Python (Flask) API and Angular frontend, containerised with Docker and deployed to Azure.
